cgJson :: J -> String

cgCommas :: [String] -> String

cgString :: String -> String
cgString s = '"' : P.foldr cgChar "\"" s

cgChar :: Char -> String -> String
cgChar c rest

  | c P.== '\\' = '\\' : '\\' : rest
  | n P.>= 32 P.&& n P.< 127 = c : rest
  | n P.< 65536 = cgU n rest

swapNumbers :: (AreaLike a, ToJ b, ToJ c) => a -> b -> c -> Call
swapNumbers where_ a b = Call "swapNumbers" [areaJ where_, toJ a, toJ b]

paintEvenOdd :: AreaLike a => a -> String -> String -> Call
paintEvenOdd where_ even odd = Call "paintEvenOdd" [areaJ where_, toJ even, toJ odd]

paintByNumber :: AreaLike a => a -> Call
paintByNumber where_ = Call "paintByNumber" [areaJ where_]

paintByNumber' :: AreaLike a => a -> Int -> Call
paintByNumber' where_ shift = Call "paintByNumber" [areaJ where_, toJ shift]

paintRedBlack :: AreaLike a => a -> String -> String -> Call
paintRedBlack where_ red black = Call "paintRedBlack" [areaJ where_, toJ red, toJ black]

stamp :: (AreaLike a, ToJ c) => a -> String -> c -> Call
stamp where_ colour symbol = Call "stamp" [areaJ where_, toJ colour, toJ symbol]

mixPaint :: AreaLike a => a -> String -> String -> Call
mixPaint where_ a b = Call "mixPaint" [areaJ where_, toJ a, toJ b]

swapSuits :: AreaLike a => a -> String -> String -> Call
swapSuits where_ a b = Call "swapSuits" [areaJ where_, toJ a, toJ b]

setSuit :: AreaLike a => a -> String -> Call
setSuit where_ suit = Call "setSuit" [areaJ where_, toJ suit]
